title: التفويض وقت الأثر
rule:
Applies when: Before a consequential action.
Revalidate trusted actor, target, grant, policy and relevant state immediately before the effect and after waits or retries.
rationale: منحة قديمة أو هدف متغير قد ينفذ أثراً غير مصرح. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
